dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Xochicuicatl Records, the foremost musical vault in the People of the Springs. All sorts of records here for sale!"

dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Full of creative inspiration, but don't know how to put your work to pen, much less to product? Leave it to us. We provide assistance from steps A to Z!"

dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Composing, recording, producing... There are dozens of steps, and we do 'em all! Leave these affairs to your friendly representatives here at Xochicuicatl Records — your best music-making partners!"
